title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess Cour 2 Reveals Teaser Trailer Ahead of January 2027 Debut
content:
Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court has released a teaser trailer for its second cour, which will begin airing in January 2027. The new episodes covering the The First Royal Outing arc were announced immediately after Cour 1 finished, and they are set to continue the story of Kou Reirin and Shu Keigetsu. Their relationship has now developed into a friendship, and the pair will be traveling to the southern territory governed by the Shu family.

The cast members joining Though I Am an Inept Villainess in Cour 2 are:

• Yuichi Nakamura as Kou Keikou, Reirin’s eldest brother

• Shunichi Toki as Kou Keishou, Reirin’s second-eldest brother

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Unran, who was described as ‘the young leader of a village in the southern territories who becomes an important figure as the story expands.‘

You can watch the new trailer below.

You can also watch an English sub version of the trailer:

Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court is a Japanese light novel series by Satsuki Nakamura. It was first published online on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in July 2020. Later that year, in December, Ichijinsha released the print edition featuring illustrations by YukiKana. Around the same time, a manga adaptation illustrated by Ei Ohitsuji began serialization in Monthly Comic Zero Sum. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed both the light novel and manga in English, describing the story for the former: In the Kingdom of Ei, five clans put forth their maidens as imperial consorts—but only one will be crowned empress. Just when frail and beautiful “court butterfly” Kou Reirin seems poised to marry the crown prince, jealous “court rat” Shu Keigetsu steals her body! Reirin wakes up in the dungeons as the conspirator, and things look dire…or do they? Now that she’s got a robust new body, not even the looming threat of execution can stop her!

We recently had the chance to interview Hana Hishikawa , the voice of Leelee.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kaiju No. 8 Final Movie Announced for 2027 as Anime Conclusion
content:
Kaiju No. 8: The Movie will officially conclude with the series as a theatrical film set for release in 2027, bringing the anime series to its final chapter on the big screen. The movie will follow the first two seasons of the TV anime and serve as the conclusion to the entire adaptation. It was originally announced during Jump Festa 2026 alongside the Narumi’s Week at Work 4-episode special.

A super teaser visual was revealed alongside the announcement featuring the tagline, “The age of humanity ends.” Studio Production I.G is returning to handle the animation production for the film.

Masaya Fukunishi, who voices Kafka Hibino, commented:

“After the broadcasts of Seasons 1 and 2, we’ve been able to enjoy the Kaiju No. 8 anime together with everyone. And now, in 2027, this series will finally reach its conclusion with a theatrical film! Next year will also be the year I turn 32, the same age as Kafka. I can’t help but feel that there’s something fateful about reaching the final chapter at this particular moment…! Until the very, very end, I’ll continue giving everything I have to creating this work that I love so much, together with my beloved Kafka Hibino and Kaiju No. 8. Thank you for all your support!!”

Studio Production I.G is animating again, with Studio Khara back in charge of the creature designs. The anime so far released a total of 23 episodes between April 13, 2024 and September 27, 2025.

The Kaiju No. 8 manga by Naoya Matsumoto began serialization in July 2020 on Shueisha’s Shonen Jump+ platform. The manga series officially ended in July with Chapter 129 and was compiled into a total of 16 volumes. Viz Media is publishing it in English, describing the story: Kafka hopes to one day keep his pact with his childhood friend Mina to join the Japan Defense Force and fight by her side. But while she’s out neutralizing kaiju as Third Division captain, Kafka is stuck cleaning up the aftermath of her battles. When a sudden rule change makes Kafka eligible for the Defense Force, he decides to try out for the squad once more. There’s just one problem—he’s made the Defense Force’s neutralization list under the code name Kaiju No. 8.

The game adaptation of the franchise, Kaiju No. 8 THE GAME , exceeded 750,000 million pre-registrations and launched worldwide on August 31, 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kaiju No. 8 Anime's 'Conclusion Arc' Revealed as Film Opening in 2027
content:
TOHO animation revealed on Saturday that the "conclusion arc" announced last December for the anime based on Naoya Matsumoto 's Kaiju No. 8 manga will be a film that will open in 2027. TOHO animation also revealed a "super teaser visual" video for the announcement.

The official English X (formerly Twitter ) account for the franchise stated the film is titled Kaiju No. 8 : The Final Mission .

The tagline on the below "super teaser" visual reads, "The era of humans is over." Art director Shinji Kimura drew the visual.

Shigeyuki Miya is returning to direct the film at Production I.G .

The anime's cast had reunited for a "Defense Force Boot Camp in Tachikawa" event on Saturday at the Tachikawa Stage Garden in Tokyo.

Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment screened the compilation film of the first season, titled Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon , "in an event-style release" in theaters in the United States and Canada in April 2025. The screenings were available in both Japanese with English subtitles, and dubbed in English.

The television anime's second season debuted on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels in July 2025. The second season also streamed on X/ Twitter worldwide in real time as it aired on TV in Japan. Crunchyroll streamed the new season.

The Narumi's Week at Work anime short debuted on September 5 and had four episodes, streaming once a week until September 25. Crunchyroll also streamed the anime.

Viz Media is releasing the manga in English digitally and physically . Shueisha also publishes the manga digitally on its MANGA Plus service, and it describes the story:

A man working a job far removed from his childhood dreams gets wrapped up in an unexpected situation…! Becoming a monster, he aims once again to fulfill his lifelong dream…!

Matsumoto launched the manga in July 2020 on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ website. The manga ended in July 2025.

Kaiju No. 8 the Game , the smartphone and PC game inspired by the franchise, launched for PC via Steam in October 2025. The game launched for iOS and Android in August 2025.

title: Gachiakuta Confirms Release Date for Its Return After a Long Hiatus
content:
Fans of Kei Urana’s grungy dystopian sci-fi shonen Gachiakuta have been anxiously waiting to hear any word from the creator or Weekly Shonen Magazine on when the series will be returning following a three month long hiatus after the release of Chapter 173 in August. However, it seems as though the series will finally be returning with an official release date for Chapter 174 being set for November 11, 2026 in a post made by Kei Urana on X (formerly Twitter).

While details are still sparse regarding why the series went on hiatus for so long, with the author citing she planned to take a research break in preparation for the next arc, the news of the series’s return is very exciting for fans. Gachiakuta went on hiatus following the conclusion of the Doll Festival arc , which has been running for well over a year. Each story arc in Gachiakuta has progressively been getting longer, with the Doll Festival arc have forty-three chapters worth of content.

Kei Urana’s Return To Gachiakuta Is More Than Welcome By Fans

Gachiakuta ‘s recent hiatus is only the second recorded break the manga has taken since it began releasing in 2022, with its first ever break occurring earlier in 2026 while the Doll Festival arc was still being released. Similar to the manga’s recent hiatus, this break was also to gather research information for Kei Urana to use in the series. Being the manga’s tenth major story arc, the Doll Festival arc took place in Andio and followed the Cleaners as theyu try to track down the individual responsible for creating mind controlling chokers. The Doll Festival itself takes place on Halloween, and the arc goes all-out with its artistic direction, and even features illustrations of the main cast dressed up in special costumes.

The Doll Festival arc ends with an explosive battle against an Eldritch-like entity after Mymo attempts to become something akin to a god. The arc ends with the entire cast rattled by the events, and with very little information being provided by Kei Urana on where the series plans to go once it returns to serialization in November, it’s a mystery what the main focus will be going forward. However, there are a number of plot threads that still need to be tied up, especially those surrounding Rudo and Alto.

Gachiakuta Has Rapidly Become a Global Phenomenon

With the first season of its anime adaptation concluded, a second on the way from BONES, and the manga finally returning in November, Gachiakuta fans have a lot to look forward to as the series continues to skyrocket in popularity. Kei Urana’s multi-award-winning series has 19-collected volumes currently released, and while Kodansha hasn’t disclosed exactly how many copies of the manga are in circulation, Oricon’s annual report for 2026 has confirmed that Gachiakuta has sold over 400,000 copies in Japan.

The series is also incredibly popular among Western audiences, with the anime adaptation in particular surging to the top of Crunchyroll’s popularity charts in the United States, managing to temporarily overtake massive shows like One Piece . With the second season of the anime currently in production, as well as a video game adaptation titled GACHIAKUTA: BREAKOUT being scheduled to release in 2027, which will be a survival action title adapting the manga and giving fans of the franchise a brand-new way to experience the original story.

title: DJ, Voice Actress Eriko Nakamura Performs in Bengaluru at Japan Habba 2027
content:
Singer May Nakabayashi , best known as the singing voice of Macross Frontier 's Sheryl Nome under her stage name May'n , will be the headliner for the 2027 event and the event will also host voice actor Kanna Nakamura as a guest. The event will host Love Live! Sunshine!! voice actress Kanako Takatsuki as a guest. It will host musician Lotus Juice and the artist's performance will be on January 10 at 6:00 p.m. IST. Asaka , Kanapon, and Nanometer will also perform at the event.

The staff describes the event:

Since its inception in 2005, Japan Habba has been at the forefront of promoting Indo-Japanese cultural exchange. The event serves as a platform for enthusiasts to experience the essence of Japan and connect with like-minded individuals.

The Japan Habba 2025 event took place on January 12 and hosted controversial mascot character Chiitan, a Hello Kitty mascot, idol group Nanometer, musical ensemble Ryoma Quartet, and musician Kanapon. The event also included anime screenings, a manga workshop, "Light Novel Title Mad Libs," a karaoke competition, yukata wearing activity, a Japanese cinema seminar, as well as several Japanese food stalls. The cosplay events included a cosplay showcase, a " cosplay chess" event, and a dedicated gaming tournament for cosplayers .

The 2023 event hosted a Tech & Jobs Fair on May 13 and a Cultural Festival on May 14 at the National Science Seminar Complex and Satish Dhawan Auditorium, Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. It hosted a seminar titled "The Greatest Artistic Movement in Anime," which spoke of the moe movement and drew on the works of Patrick Galbraith and Eiji Ootsuka. The Animathon quiz had over 200 participants and team "Cardcaptor Sakuga" won the grand prize. Finalists in the quiz won Bocchi the Rock! keychains. The Cultural Festival also had a cosplay showcase, Pokémon Go event, and Smash Bros Ultimate tournament. Tomokuni Terukina, "a sanshin master of the Afuso-ryu school," performed on stage on May 14. The event featured stalls selling anime and manga merchandise as well as activities involving tea ceremony, calligraphy, ikebana, and origami, and traditional Japanese food.
author: ANN

title: AFA Singapore Screens Asian Premiere of Bless TV Anime
content:
The AFA Singapore convention announced on Thursday that it will screen the Asian premiere of the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga. The screening will take place at the convention's NEXT Stage on November 27.

The AFA Singapore convention will take place at the Suntec Singapore International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Singapore on November 27 to 29.

The anime will star:

• Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa

• Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Ginga Yoyogi

• Yoshino Aoyama as Oroka Sumeragi

• Momoka Terasawa as Shitataka Sumeragi

• Kentarō Kumagai as MM

• Yoshiki Nakajima as Joe Osaki

• Kōki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano

• Tarusuke Shingaki as Hikaru Oya

Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , and Takayuki Kikuchi (episode director for Solo Leveling , Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is the assistant director. Fukurou Kamiza ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)

• Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou

• Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)

• Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)

• Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki

• Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)

• Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)

• Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)

• CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi

• Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida

• Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha published the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.

Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.
Other staff members include:
Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)
Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou
Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)
Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)
Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki
Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)
Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)
Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)
CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi
Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)
Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose
Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida
Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa
Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha published the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.
The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.

title: QCinema Film Festival Screns Live-Action Look Back Film in the Philippines
content:
The QCinema International Film Festival in Quezon City, Metro Manila announced on Friday that it will screen the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot as the closing film of the festival.

The festival will screen films at Gateway Cineplex 18, Robinsons Galleria, TriNoma, Fisher Box Office, and SM City Fairview from November 13 to 22.

The film opened on September 11 in Japan at #5. The film earned 144,146,120 yen (about US929,800) in its first three days.

The 79th Cannes International Film Festival showcased the film on May 15. The London Film Festival screened the film in October. The film won the UNIMED (Mediterranean Universities Union) student jury's UNIMED award in September.

The Cannes International Film Festival describes the film:

Spanning more than a decade, Hirokazu Kore-eda 's tender coming-of-age story follows two girls who bond over their passion for and dream of becoming manga artists. Fujino, a gifted artist and aspiring manga artist, meets Kymoto, a shy admirer of her work. Seemingly opposites, they create the perfect team with their shared love of the form. But as their work draws praise and attention, they find themselves confronted with decisions that threaten their artistic collaboration. Koreeda's beautiful love letter to friendship and the creative process offers keen insight into the craft.

Aju Makita ( Child of Kamiari Month , Happiness ) plays Kyōmoto, while Natsuki Deguchi ( I Have a S/e/c/r/e/t/, Blue Spring Ride ) plays Fujino in the film.

Hirokazu Kore-eda ( Shoplifters , Our Little Sister , Air Doll ) directed and edited the film, and also wrote the screenplay. Yūta Bandō ( BELLE , Kaiju No. 8 , also known as Taku Matsushiba ) composed the music.

The staff also includes:

• Photography: Senzo Ueno

• Lighting: Masachio Nishida

• Sound: Kazuhiko Tomita

• Art Direction: Shinsuke Kojima

• Costume Design: Sachiko Ito

• Hair and Makeup Supervision: Katsuhiko Yūmi

• Assistant Director: Kensei Nakayama

• Scripter: Ryōko Taguchi

• Casting: Toshie Tabata, Yōko Yamashita

• VFX Supervisor: Rinto Ueda

• Line Producer: Shinichi Muraoka

Musician Kenshi Yonezu , actress and singer Tōko Miura , and animator and director Yōko Kuno have special guest staff roles in the film. Yonezu performs guitar for the film, credited under the "Shark Kick Guitar" moniker, while Miura performs vocals for an insert song in the film. Kuno directed a rotoscoped animation sequence based on their performance, with Shinei Animation producing the animation.

Fujimoto debuted the one-shot manga on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ in July 2021. The manga had over 2.5 million views on its first day. Viz Media and MANGA Plus launched the manga digitally in English. Viz Media published the manga in print in September 2022.

The anime film adaptation of Fujimoto's " Look Back " one-shot manga opened in theaters in Japan in June 2024. It ranked at #2 in terms of ticket sales (but #1 in weekend earnings) in its opening weekend. The film sold 135,000 tickets and earned 227 million (about US$1.40 million) in its first three days.

Encore Films screened the film in theaters in Southeast Asia.

Fujimoto ( Fire Punch ) debuted the Chainsaw Man manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in December 2018 and ended its "first part," the "Kōan" (Public Safety) arc, in December 2020. The manga's second part, titled "Gakkō-hen" (School Arc), started on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service in July 2022, and it ended on March 24 (March 25 in Japan).

title: PVR Inox Certifies Road to Ninja: Naruto the Movie Anime Film with Indian Censor Board
content:
The film opened in July 2012 and featured a story and character designs personally created by original manga creator Masashi Kishimoto .

Eleven Arts released the film in the United States and describes the film:

In the latest NARUTO SHIPPUDEN feature film, long ago, a mysterious masked shinobi unleashed the Nine-Tailed Fox onto the Village Hidden in the Leaves to spread chaos and destruction. But the Fourth Hokage, Minato Namikaze, and his wife Kushina Uzumaki sealed the Tailed Beast into their newborn son, N aruto, to save the village, foiling the shinobi's plan. Years later, N aruto and his friends succeed in driving away the infamous Akatsuki, who have mysteriously returned from the dead. Upon returning to the village, the young shinobi are praised by their families for completing a dangerous mission. Reminded of how alone he is, N aruto begins to wonder what it's like to have parents, when a strange masked figure appears before him – the same masked shinobi responsible for the death of his parents!

Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow screened in Indian theaters in June 2025. The film screened in Japanese with English subtitles, with a Hindi dub , and with an English dub in several locations.

Reliance Entertainment entered a deal with TV Tokyo and Happening 365 in April 2025 in order to release the Naruto films in Indian theaters.

Thanks to Divyansh Agarwal for the news tip.

title: Odex to Theatrically Screen Detective Conan 2-Hour Anime Special in Singapore, Philippines
content:
Odex announced on Thursday that it will screen Detective Conan: 30-gō Satsujin Jiken (The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30) , the franchise 's first new two-hour special in 10 years, in cinemas in Singapore and the Philippines. Odex did not reveal when the screenings will begin, but noted that screenings in Singapore will be exclusive to Golden Village Cinemas, while the Philippine screenings will be exclusive to SM Cinemas.

The special debuted in Japan on September 25.

In the special, Conan and the others take on a threat to the nation — the release of counterfeit bills. They visit the National Printing Bureau in Nagano, and then Conan and Heiji head to Osaka where the counterfeit bills were apparently printed.

Gōshō Aoyama launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Shounen Sunday magazine in 1994. The manga has spawned a television anime that has been running since January 1996, as well as an accompanying anime film series.

The manga series centers on Conan Edogawa, the alias of detective Shinichi Kudo, whose body shrunk after being poisoned at the beginning of the story. Together with detective Kogoro Mori and his daughter Ran, Conan helps the police solve difficult mysteries.
